title: Turn Recorded Failures into Independently Verified and Protected Repair Procedures
target_platform: Local deterministic fault fixture harness; record_procedure_outcome.py; cheap repair worker (ceiling 800k tokens, 8 CPU-hours)
hypothesis: A pipeline that minimizes failures, creates independently validated regression tests, and stores repair preconditions will: (a) repair >= 70% of held-out related faults; (b) improve repair success by >= 20 percentage points over ordinary failure-log retrieval; (c) reduce median repair inference tokens by >= 25%; and (d) introduce zero regressions on the protected hidden suite.
falsification_criteria: Fail if any threshold is missed, or if a repair passes by deleting tests, weakening assertions, bypassing the failing feature, or altering the evaluator.
experiment: Use 20 development failures and 60 held-out faults in small fixture repositories. Separate by root-cause variant, not just filename. Compare ordinary logs, a retrieved prior patch, and a structured procedure containing trigger, diagnosis, minimal counterexample, repair, and applicability limits. Cap each repair at 2 attempts.

model_routing.frontier_escalation_condition: Escalate to bounded standard adjudication solely for evaluating subtle test assertion weakening.

related_missions.MISSION-015: INTERVENTION UNDER: provides explicit empirical self-improvement mechanism without self-deception.
related_missions.MISSION-036: CONSUMES: grounds repair validations in strict evidence contracts.
related_missions.MISSION-041: CONSUMES: uses automated counterexample generation to build regression protections.

resources: disposable repository fixtures; max 800k inference tokens, 8 CPU-hours
projected_impact.basis: Declared 2026-11-04 upon intake of Astra candidate N11. Refine at checkout and confirm with `manage_coordination.py verify`.
